# Results by neighbourhood income (generated by `src/segment_by_income.py`)

Stores split at the median income of their trading area (1990 census). Each half is modelled separately. Same assumptions as `pricing.md`.

| Group | Stores | StarKist own elasticity | Chicken of the Sea own elasticity | Bumble Bee own elasticity | Dominick's own elasticity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lower-income stores | 42 | -2.91 (se 0.14) | -3.04 (se 0.12) | -2.42 (se 0.27) | -1.30 (se 0.12) |
| Higher-income stores | 41 | -2.32 (se 0.12) | -3.10 (se 0.13) | -2.51 (se 0.32) | -1.19 (se 0.11) |
